## Versioned review-policy and bridge recovery

Upgrade maps legacy review enablement to an explicit delivery mode, marks every
non-closed declared wave for re-Prepare, and keeps publication blocked while the
upgrade checkpoint exists. A protocol-1 runner must refuse an incompatible feature
pack before extraction and direct the operator to the release's bridge zip,
bootstrap, and selection manifest. After all attached hosts and the dashboard are
stopped, the bridge returns a path-safe second-hop command bound to the feature
SHA-256; resume retained failures until cleanup completes.
